name: Article 10, § 1, point a – 118
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
part_text: (a) ensure that the establishments under their responsibility receive a visit by a veterinarian by year after the date of application of this Regulation or within the first year of the notification of a new establishment, for the purpose of identifying and assessing any risk factor for the welfare of the dogs and cats and advising the operator on measures to address any risk factor for animal welfare and to follow up on actions taken by the operator in response to recommendations made by visiting veterinarian; thereafter the visits from a veterinarian shall take place when appropriate, based on a risk analysis by the competent authorities; Member States may provide for that the advisory welfare visits are annual;
